Name: Elfsquad7
Overview: The North Pole is in trouble and only you can help in ELFSQUAD7. Go solo or team up with your friends and family in a co-op Christmas adventure! Use your skills to stuff Santa's sac, smash freakish toys, fight Kevin - the haywire toy-building robot, and save Christmas for everyone! Santa needs your help! ELFSQUAD7...ASSEMBLE!
